in_marathi.name: Dhanush
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanush हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva wields a bow named Dhanush. It is also the name of various gods and heroes. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanus' meaning bow or weapon.
